verdict.rationale: Undermind's own docs say teams can "Collaborate on shared workspaces" and manage team members. Reports and notes live in the workspace, which implies collaborators could view and build on them. However, the sharing claim is a single marketing line with no detail on how sharing works. missing for 10: documented mechanics for sharing a specific session or report (links, invites), view vs. edit permission controls, collaborative editing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can share a research session or report with collaborators who can view or build on it

citations.quote: Creates and edits Markdown notes, syntheses, and reports in the workspace.
